messages:
pagerduty-bot: [ALERT] GPU nodepool 'inference-eu-west' at max_nodes=12, pending queue growth > 400 for 3 minutes. Incident severity: P1.

sre-oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Seeing a steady queue increase on the gen workers.

eng-runtime: fwiw, we're seeing a spike in short chat sessions that keeps reloading KV cache. Token throughput up x3.

sre-oncall: Can someone paste the autoscaler logs? I want to confirm why it didn't scale past 12.

deploy-bot: autoscaler-controller: scale attempt at 2026-03-15T15:14:20Z -> desired: 15, but maxNodes enforced: 12 (nodepool annotation: cloud.maxNodes=12)

infra-lead: Confirmed. Pool has a hard limit from the terraform config. It's blocking autoscale.

product-ops: Customer impact - CS is seeing increased generation latency and some 502s for queued requests in the eu-west region. Flagging top 3 accounts that hit the queue: acme-inc, zenai, learnly.

cs-rep: CS confirmed: acme-inc reported API timeouts starting ~15:12 UTC, ~1.2% of requests 502, impact on production. They're on a paid Dedicated plan.

sre-oncall: Ok we need a manual cap raise. What are constraints? infra-lead: cloud quota allows +8 nodes, but terraform guardrails require an approval for permanent change. We can do a temporary bump via the cloud console/patch.

eng-runtime: If we get +6 nodes quickly that should absorb current queued backlog. Also suggest enabling a temporary conservative eviction policy: set podPriority for low-priority batch to preempt.

sre-oncall: Proposed plan: 1) Manual nodepool max bump to 18 (temporary) 2) Patch HPA/autoscaler to allow desired 18 3) Monitor queue and latency 4) Rollback after stabilization. Approvers: infra-lead + ops lead.

infra-lead: I'm +1 for temporary bump to 18. We should annotate and log the action.

deploy-bot: Needed command (example):
```
# patch nodepool max
gcloud container node-pools update inference-eu-west --max-nodes=18 --cluster=redwood-eu
# patch annotation used by autoscaler
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap autoscaler-config --patch '{"data":{"max_nodes_inference-eu-west":"18"}}'
```

sre-oncall: I'm going to run the gcloud update now. Will also add a tag `temp-autoscale-bump/3792468110` for tracking.

sre-oncall: running...

sre-oncall: gcloud response: Operation "update-node-pool-1234" started. ETA ~3m.

eng-runtime: While we wait, let's divert new low-priority jobs to the warm cache pool:
```
kubectl label pod -n ml batch-worker batch-tier=warm --selector=job=batch
```

deploy-bot: cloud operation completed at 2026-03-15T15:18:05Z. New maxNodes=18 live.

sre-oncall: Patching autoscaler config to reflect new max.

sre-oncall: kubectl patch applied. Autoscaler attempted scale to desired 16 -> provisioning nodes.

sre-oncall: Nodes coming up: node-gpu-a, node-gpu-b, node-gpu-c... 

pagerduty-bot: [UPDATE] Queue length peaked at 678, now trending down to 230.

cs-rep: CS: acme-inc confirms error rate dropping, latency improving. They still saw a ~3 minute outage window but are back online.

product-ops: Marking impact: partial degradation for eu-west customers for ~18 minutes (15:12-15:30 UTC). Notifying account reps.

infra-lead: Reminder: this is a temporary manual bump. We must revert to the terraform-controlled max=12 after postmortem and decision. Create a ticket.

eng-runtime: Observed some pod evictions as nodes spun up (expected). No workloads OOMed. KV cache miss ratio increased during the spike; we'll run a short cache warm job.

sre-oncall: Metrics summary while scaling: avg latency (gen) went 400ms -> 1.8s peak, 502 rate 1.2% peak, total queued requests peaked 678. After +6 nodes, queue drained to <50 in 9 minutes.

infra-lead: I created infra/INC-3792468110 with tags and the terraform PR blocker note.

product-ops: Action items: 1) CS follow-up notes to affected accounts (cs-rep) 2) eng-runtime to run cache warm job and tune eviction 3) infra to evaluate whether increasing default nodepool cap makes sense 4) SRE to draft postmortem.

cs-rep: I'll send a templated note to the three affected customers and set follow-up calls if requested.

eng-runtime: I'll schedule a cache-warm job and open a perf regression check for the KV cache behavior.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor for 30m, then initiate rollback to max=12 unless infra requests otherwise.

infra-lead: Sounds good. I'll coordinate the terraform PR for a controlled policy change if we want to make the bump permanent after review.

sre-oncall: Closing update: system stable, queue < 20, no ongoing customer errors. Leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [AUDIT] Manual nodepool update by sre-oncall at 2026-03-15T15:18:05Z, tag=temp-autoscale-bump/3792468110.

sre-oncall: Postmortem TODO: capture root cause (workload pattern spike vs autoscaler tuning), consider autoscaler policy change (cooldown, max burst), improve alerting thresholds for queued tokens, and add a runbook step for manual cap bump.

infra-lead: Adding runbook entry and tagging owners.

product-ops: Thanks everyone. If anything else pops, ping this thread.

sre-oncall: end of shifts handoff -> will hand to oncall SRE in EU in 30m.

pagerduty-bot: [RESOLVE] Incident acknowledged and mitigated.
